initial_plan.can_answer: yes, if the file contains complete 2013–2025 coverage; it directly records pedestrian deaths per crash
initial_plan.metric: Annual total pedestrians killed, calculated as the sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed across crash records
initial_plan.denominator: None; this is a total count, not a rate
initial_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
initial_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive, using calendar year of crash_date

data_check_interpretation.rows: There are 2,132,218 crash records in the 2013–2025 population. Each of the 13 years has observations spanning January 1 through December 31, so no requested year is partial.
data_check_interpretation.date_quality: No crash_date values are missing across the file (0 of 2,269,187), and none of the checked common sentinel dates occur. No year can be assigned to a missing date, so none are dropped for that reason.
data_check_interpretation.outcome_quality: number_of_pedestrians_killed is missing on 0 of 2,132,218 population rows; no rows are excluded or treated differently for outcome missingness.
data_check_interpretation.decision: Keep all records with crash_date in 2013–2025 and sum the recorded pedestrian-death count; exclude records outside the requested years. The file covers all requested years fully.

final_plan.metric: Annual total pedestrians killed, calculated by summing number_of_pedestrians_killed across police-reported NYC crash records in each calendar year
final_plan.denominator: None; a total count, not a rate
final_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
final_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; each year has observed records spanning the full calendar year
final_plan.missingness_decision: Keep every in-period crash row; the summed field is missing on 0 of 2,132,218 rows, so none are omitted for outcome missingness.
final_plan.limitations: The measure is based on police-reported crash records and is a count without a population or exposure denominator. Records outside 2013–2025 are outside scope; none of the requested years is partial, and the date and outcome fields have no missing values in the checked populations.
